title: Fix root pytest collection across worker test modules
description: Running pytest -q from the repo root fails during collection because multiple worker folders contain test_golden_soda_pmuoneq_normuon.py with the same import module name. Root optimizer tests pass, but global pytest collection needs worker package isolation or unique test module names.

title: Remove obsolete fallback decay ablation
description: The optimizer API no longer exposes a separate fallback decay option. AnchorMuon now uses SODA as the only regularization path, so this ablation task is obsolete.
